badge.openHint: People who have access can contribute.
badge.membersOnlyHint: Only the people allowed by the creator can contribute.

description.wordGroup: Let other people add words to this group.
description.groupCollection: Let other people add groups to this collection.

contributors.wordGroup: Allowed people can add words, and edit or delete their own. With a full sharing, they can edit and delete every word.
contributors.groupCollection: Allowed people can add groups, and remove the ones they added. With a full sharing, they can remove every group.

closed.wordGroup: When closed, only you can change the list; the words already added are kept.
closed.groupCollection: When closed, only you can change its groups; the ones already added are kept.

privateClosed.wordGroup: When private and closed, the group is only visible to you: its members get their access back if it is reopened.
privateClosed.groupCollection: When private and closed, the collection is only visible to you: its members get their access back if it is reopened.

everyone.wordGroup: Everyone who can see the group
everyone.groupCollection: Everyone who can see the collection

membersOnly.label: Only the people I allow
membersOnly.description: Everyone can view it, but only the people you accept through the share link can contribute.

inviteHint.edition: Once saved, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section, just below.

creation.wordGroup: Once the group is created, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section.
creation.groupCollection: Once the collection is created, invite these people with the link of the “Sharing” section.
